name: Dynamic Chest Stretch
steps: Stand tall with your feet shoulder-width apart and raise both arms straight out in front of you at shoulder height.
Swing your arms smoothly out wide behind you with palms facing forward until you feel an open stretch across your chest and front shoulders.
Pause briefly at the open position with your shoulder blades drawn together, then bring your arms back across the front of your body.
Continue moving smoothly between the open stretch and cross-body position for the full duration.
tips: Keep your ribs down and core lightly braced so your lower back does not arch as your arms open.
Move with controlled momentum rather than flinging your arms forcefully backward.
